[SERVICE DOMAIN: Position Keeping] BIAN Service Landscape V14.0 - vista MATRIX
UBICACION Business Area : Operations and Execution Business Domain : Cross Product Operations Anidado : Account Management (capacidad de negocio agrupadora, no un nivel del metamodelo)
BUSINESS DEFINITION (proposito) This service domain maintains a log of monetary or value transactions and entitlements log posted to product facilities. Reconciled financial transactions are subsequently used for posting to the accounting systems.
METAMODELO Control Record = Asset Type + Generic Artifact Functional Pattern : Track Asset Type : Financial Position Generic Artifact : Log Control Record : Financial Position Log
ESTRUCTURA DEL CONTROL RECORD (Financial Position Log Instance Record, 22 atributos) Transaction Log Type | Product Instance Reference | Customer Reference | Counterparty Reference | Base Currency | Interest Application Record | Interest Transaction | Transaction Description | Transaction Rate Type | Transaction Interest Charge | Managed Position Limits | Position Limit Type | Position Limit Settings | Position Limit Value | Amount Block | Amount Block Type | Priority | Amount | Date Type | Date | Initiation Date | Status
BEHAVIOR QUALIFIERS (1) Financial Transaction Capture (3 atributos)
INTERFAZ Y COMPORTAMIENTO OPERATIVO Action Terms : Initiate Update Control Retrieve Capture Inbound service operations : 7 Outbound service events : 4
Que Action Term activa que Behavior Qualifier: Control Record <- Initiate, Update, Control, Retrieve BQ FinancialTransactionCapture <- Update, Capture, Retrieve
MODELO DE DATOS Y SEMANTICA BOM mapping (AsyncAPI 3.x) : Si ISO 20022 / Semantics Alignment : Si API semantica publicada : Si
